disclaimer: FICTIONAL SAMPLE DATA for an unofficial student demo. These are not official CDF records, contracts, payments, or government figures. Ward coordinates are approximate public locations so the markers sit in the right part of Lusaka. Do not use this file for oversight, payment, or audit decisions.

projects.description: Fictional sample. A made-up classroom desk order for Kamwala ward. In this file the budget is fully spent and the status is still delayed, so the page can show a paid-but-not-done flag. It is not a real delivery and it is not part of the Auditor General figure.
